## AI-generated validation report (NOT for publication)

**Status**: Draft reference report for internal use only.  
**Important**: This document was **generated by AI** from the current validation pipeline outputs and code structure. It is **not publication-ready** and must be **reviewed carefully by a human** before any external use.

### Purpose

- **Goal**: Retrospectively evaluate the GDO proportion-based dengue nowcasting method using a moving-window, leave-one-season-out design.
- **Primary questions**:
  - **Accuracy vs season progress**: How error changes as more of the season is observed (`cutoff_month`).
  - **Country heterogeneity**: Which countries perform well/poorly and whether performance correlates with simple features (burden, seasonal-profile stability).
  - **Uncertainty calibration**: Whether empirical prediction intervals have nominal coverage, and produce an operational interval lookup table.
  - **Pipeline stability**: How nowcast estimates change across stored pipeline snapshots.

### Nowcasting method being validated (point forecasts)

- **Core mechanism** (per country-season):
  - Let c_t be cumulative observed cases up to season-month `cutoff_month = t`.
  - Let \bar{P}_t be the **average cumulative seasonal proportion** at month t, estimated from historical seasons.
  - Predict total seasonal cases:
    - **Predicted_total** = c_t / \bar{P}_t
  - For each unobserved month m>t, predict:
    - **predicted_cases(m)** = \text{Predicted_total} \times \bar{p}_m
    - where \bar{p}_m is the **average monthly proportion** at season-month m from the baseline.

### Validation design (retrospective simulation)

- **Unit of evaluation**: country × season × cutoff_month × predicted season-month.
- **Cross-validation**: **Leave-one-season-out** per country:
  - **Test season**: one complete season held out.
  - **Training seasons**: all other complete seasons for that country.
  - This avoids leakage (test season does not contribute to its own baseline).
- **Moving-window truncation**:
  - For each test season, simulate real-time availability by truncating at `cutoff_month = 1..11`.
  - Months `1..cutoff_month` treated as observed; months `cutoff_month+1..12` predicted and compared to truth.

### Data and inclusion filters (as implemented upstream)

- Validation inputs are based on the season-aligned historical dataset produced by the existing pipeline scripts.
- Countries/seasons are filtered by the seasonal-baseline procedure (e.g., complete seasons and minimum case/seasons constraints).
- Output coverage depends on the set of locations passing these filters at run time.

### Metrics computed

- **Per-prediction errors** (in `validation_results_detail.csv`):
  - **absolute_error** = predicted − actual
  - **APE** (absolute percentage error) = |pred-actual|/actual when `actual>0` (else NA)
  - **relative_error** = (pred-actual)/actual when `actual>0` (else NA)
- **Aggregations**:
  - **Country-level**: MAE, RMSE, RMSPE, empirical coverage, mean logscore.
  - **Cutoff-level**: medians and coverages by `cutoff_month`.
  - **Country × cutoff**: same metrics by `iso3` and `cutoff_month`.

### Uncertainty (prediction intervals)

- Two uncertainty products are present:
  - **NB-style intervals** stored per prediction (used for coverage metrics).
  - **Empirically calibrated residual quantiles** exported as an operational lookup table for dashboard use.
- **Operational lookup artifact**:
  - File: `../../Assets/Stable/calibrated_prediction_intervals.csv`
  - Mirror: `table5_calibrated_prediction_intervals.csv`
  - Indexed by: `iso3`, `cutoff_month`, `horizon`
    - `horizon = season_nMonth - cutoff_month` (months-ahead)
  - Contains residual quantiles (e.g., `q025_rel`, `q975_rel`) used to construct 50%/95% bands around point forecasts.
  - Includes fallback logic when sample size is low (country → region → global).

### Headline results (from current outputs)

- **Reliable horizon**:
  - File: `reliable_horizon.txt`
  - Current run reports: **median RMSPE < 0.25 was not reached** at any `cutoff_month`.
- **Accuracy vs cutoff_month**:
  - Source: `table2_cutoff_accuracy_summary.csv`
  - Median APE is roughly **0.46–0.55** across cutoff months in this run (see Table 2 for exact values).
- **Interval calibration**:
  - Source: `calibration_summary.csv`
  - Empirical coverage in this run:
    - **95% interval**: ~**0.848** (under-coverage vs 0.95)
    - **50% interval**: ~**0.423** (under-coverage vs 0.50)
  - Interpretation: intervals are **too narrow** on average (under-dispersed) and should be treated as provisional.

### Country performance classification (as currently implemented)

- **Tiering**:
  - Countries are assigned **Good / Moderate / Poor** using tertiles of country-level RMSPE.
- **Correlates included (descriptive)**:
  - `n_seasons` available for the country
  - `mean_monthly_cases` and `burden_group` (High/Low relative to median)
  - `seasonal_profile_cv` (variability of average monthly proportions across season-months)

### Implementation notes (important for human review)

- **Metric definitions**:
  - Percentage-based metrics exclude months with `actual_cases == 0` (handled via NA).
  - `median_RMSPE` in Table 2 is reported as the **median APE** (see column naming; verify naming conventions before publication).
- **Uncertainty model**:
  - NB-style intervals are generated using a **fast approximation** (moment-based NB parameters) for computational tractability.
  - This impacts the NB coverage metrics; the **empirical interval lookup** is still grounded in validation residuals.
